1.0.1: Fixed missing prompt in SendPrompt output variables. Other, small internal improvements.
1.0.2: TransformTextToJSON: improved error handling for invalid JSON schema input.
1.0.3: Fixed an error `JSON schema is invalid` that occurred when the AiAgent used a tool with an empty parameters object.
1.1.0: Add mcp output port for connecting MCP servers.
Memory data store can be selected to store agent memory and summary.
New connector configuration: AI_AGENT_MAX_HISTORY_SIZE (default 512000), llmBaseUrl and llmDefaultHeaders to support other OpenAI SDK compatible LLMs.
Report usage and timing information in the output.
Better performance, assistant API exchanged for chat completion.
Support for streaming responses with built-in chat utility.
Partial agent progress reported via streams too (for built-in chat utility).
1.1.1: Fixed a bug which prevented the AI Agent from using MCP server tools.
1.1.2: Fixed OpenAI API error "tool_call_ids did not have response messages" by ensuring all tool call IDs receive responses, even when tools timeout or fail. Added comprehensive error handling for malformed JSON arguments and improved polling logic to guarantee complete tool call coverage. Enhanced logging and reliability for AI conversations when tools experience issues.
1.2.0: Added support for files. AI agent now accepts a file that can be used as additional context for the prompt.
1.2.1: Renamed the AI Agent component label to remove the OpenAI suffix for clarity in the Designer.
1.2.2: Added validation for required fields in components.
1.3.0: Introduced VariableExtractor component to specifically extract values for given variables from inputs using AI.
1.3.1: Fixed AI Agent mcpCallTool not passing correlationId, causing MCP server tool calls to appear in separate execution logs.
1.3.2: Fixed ioredis sentinel connection configuration to properly parse sentinel hosts and handle password authentication.
1.3.3: Replaced direct Redis pub/sub with tenant-isolated context pubSubPublish method.
1.3.4: GenerateImage: handle b64_json response format for gpt-image-1/gpt-image-2 models; throw CancelError when API returns neither url nor b64_json.
1.4.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the OpenAI API.
1.4.1: AI Agent: fixed OpenAI API error "Invalid value for 'content': expected a string, got null." that occurred when a tool chain produced no output. Tool results with null/undefined output are now coerced to a string before being sent to the model.
2.0.0: BREAKING: AI Agent: 'Model' and 'Instructions' moved from the component configuration to the 'in' port, so they can now be bound to flow variables (matching ai/claude and ai/gemini). Existing agents keep working: while the new inputs are left empty, the component keeps using the model and instructions from the old configuration. Fill in the new inputs to override them.
SendPrompt: added an 'Instructions' input; the system message is no longer hardcoded to 'You are a helpful assistant.'.
SendPrompt: added the 'Temperature', 'Max Tokens', 'Top P', 'Frequency Penalty' and 'Presence Penalty' inputs.
GenerateEmbeddings, GenerateEmbeddingsFromFile: removed the 'embeddingTemplate' input, which was declared in the port schema but had no inspector field and was never read by the component.

GenerateEmbeddings, GenerateEmbeddingsFromFile: the embeddings 'index' output is now correctly typed as an integer, and the required inputs declared in the schema now match what the components assert.
TransformTextToJSON: fixed a crash that made the component fail on every execution ('Cannot access jsonSchema before initialization').
TransformTextToJSON, VariableExtractor: the dynamic output-port schema request now passes ignoreAuth=true so the variable picker no longer needs an authenticated account.
DescribeImages: the 'Model' input was nested inside the 'Images' field and therefore invisible in the Designer; it is now a top-level input.
AI Agent: the 'Memory Data Store' input is now a typeahead so a store can be entered manually when the list cannot be loaded.
Added output examples to every component with a static output port so the variable picker shows realistic sample values.

CreateSpeech: fixed a crash that made the component fail on every execution ('context.httpRequest[method] is not a function'); the file extension now falls back to 'mp3' when no response format is set.
Moderate: the 'Model' input is now honoured (it was declared but ignored) and the default model is 'omni-moderation-latest', as OpenAI no longer accepts 'text-moderation-latest'.
2.0.1: AI Agent: fixed the 'Instructions' being ignored. Since 1.1.0 they were never sent to the model, so the agent answered from the prompt alone. They now lead every request, including every turn of a thread.

AI Agent: fixed the error "Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model" raised when a long thread history was being summarized. The summary is no longer capped by default (set AI_AGENT_MAX_HISTORY_SUMMARY_TOKENS to cap it), and a failed summary no longer discards the answer.
2.0.2: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
2.1.0: AI Agent: any component connected to the 'tools' port is a tool the agent calls directly, with no 'Tool Start' and 'Tool Output' around it; fields filled with the new 'Model Defined Parameter' variable become the tool parameters, a field filled with 'Prompt' gets the prompt. MCP servers can be connected to the same port. 'Tool Start' chains keep working: on a port with 'Tool Start' chains only they are called as before, next to other tools a 'Tool Start' is called through its webhook URL so the other tools do not run. The 'mcp' port keeps working.

AI Agent: a tool on the 'tools' port can be a chain of components, for example Generate Embeddings followed by a vector database query. The components connected behind the first one run as further steps of the same tool, each fed from the previous one the way the flow maps it, and the output of the last step is returned to the agent. When a step returns several items (Find Emails with one email at a time), the next step runs for each of them, up to 50 by default (AI_AGENT_TOOL_MAX_ITEMS).

AI Agent: two calls of the same 'Tool Start' in one turn no longer overwrite each other's output (they run one after the other; calls of different tools still run at the same time). A 'Tool Output' that comes after its call has timed out is removed from the flow state with the next message of the agent. The tool names the model sees for 'Tool Start' chains are shorter (the component ID is shortened).
